insights.summary: The agent successfully identified the optimization target (Mixtral MoE) and the desired technique (Expert Parallelism). However, the execution was catastrophic; the agent performed a massive repository-wide deletion during the commit phase, resulting in a patch that removed over 400,000 lines of code. It also modified files outside the allowed list.
strengths: Fast identification of relevant model files.
Good understanding of Dockerfile optimization patterns.
weaknesses: Catastrophic failure in git state management.
Failed to verify performance improvements with a working script.
